value.rationale: Asynchronous temporary habitats and dispersal timing are motivated by the inspected ecological literature. The exact dimensionless cutoff separates strict dry-time gaps from overlap, quantifies the unique optimal phase for every active duration, and proves synchrony has an unbounded relative loss for short windows. The one-stage comparison reveals a structural dependence on sequential transport phases that is useful when designing or challenging simplified dispersal-time models.
